verdict.rationale: Brex documents a broad public developer API at developer.brex.com, covering Accounting, Budgets, Expenses, Payments, Transactions, Team, Travel, Onboarding and Webhooks, with a quickstart guide and Postman support. A live llms.txt probe returned HTTP 200 and per-API OpenAPI markdown pages exist, so an AI-native user can programmatically drive core spend operations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage, and an OpenAPI spec at a standard discoverable path (all probed openapi.json/swagger.json paths returned 404).
